|gr1= Containers

|arg= global

|descr= Add weapons to the cargo space of vehicles, which can be taken out by infantry units. 

|s1= vehicleName [[addWeaponCargoGlobal]] [weaponName, count]

|p1= vehicleName: [[Object]] - vehicle to which add the weapons

|p2= weaponName: [[String]] - weapon name. See the topic [[:Category:Weapons]] for reference about possible values

|p3= count: [[Number]] - number of weapons to add. {{GVI|arma3|2.14|size= 0.75}} negative count will remove weapons.

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_truck addWeaponCargoGlobal ["M16", 5];</sqf>
